scope: One root Declaration Atom Header.Container omission fallback. Ordinary Atoms may use a full Scope Unit path or a containing base Atom ID; the base Atom ID is a Current-selection default only, not a default Header.Container.
user_decision: For root Project Declaration CA-R-2640 only, omitted Header.Container defaults to the literal string world. An explicitly supplied valid Header.Container value overrides that fallback; it is not a mandatory authored literal and is not a general Atom default.

candidate.edit: Adds an omission-only root Project Declaration world fallback with explicit valid override; keeps path/base-ID containment alternatives and clarifies that Current-selection defaulting does not default Header.Container.
